Description.header: Stream a directory of documents into RAG
Description.body: Returns a deferred request with an input directory link, an events FIFO, and an async_result FIFO. Copy completed files through input. Each file is passed to rag_add and reported through events. Read async_result for the final added and failed file report. Per-file failures are statistics and do not fail the bulk request; request-level failures still return a nonzero error_code.
Description.footer: Metadata is augmented with every component of each uploaded file path. File and directory allow/skip expressions are forwarded to streaming_directory_events. The request seals explicitly or after the uploader idle timeout.
